code='''def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 5 for x in row))
    colors = sorted({x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (0,5)})
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    growth = {c: sum(v == c for row in bottom for v in row) - sum(v == c for row in top for v in row) for c in colors}
    c = max(colors, key=lambda x: growth[x])
    return [[c,c],[c,c]]
'''
